search.title: Find Packstations
search.description: Your HA home location is selected when available. Clear it with X to enter another address or postal code. The selected address or home coordinates are sent to DHL only when you submit the search, and are not saved.

confirm.title: Review and confirm locations
confirm.description: Check the addresses and counts. — means unknown, missing or old data; the station can still be added. ⚠ means the station could not be verified. Retry or deselect these stations. Optional compartment totals per size can be added later under Edit station.

error.cannot_connect: DHL could not be reached. Try again later.
error.station_not_found: DHL did not return this exact Packstation.
error.invalid_response: DHL returned unexpected data. Try again later.
error.rate_limited: DHL is limiting requests. Wait before trying again.
error.invalid_address: Enter an address or postal code, up to 300 characters.
error.invalid_location: Enter a five-digit postal code and a positive station number with up to four digits.
error.no_stations: No new Packstations were found. Refine the address or use the station number.
error.validation_failed: Some stations could not be checked (⚠). Retry or deselect them.
error.invalid_capacities: Totals must be whole numbers between 0 and 1000. Leave unknown values empty.

abort.already_configured: DHL Packstation Monitor is already configured. Add stations to the existing entry.

reconfigure.title: Edit station
reconfigure.description: {station}: change the name and recheck the same location. Use Add station for a different Packstation. Optionally count the compartments per size on site or from a photo and enter or add them below later. These manual totals affect only the display, never DHL sensor values or availability checks. Empty fields mean unknown and remove previous values.
